# Grandma's Guardian — default scam phrase list
# One phrase per line. Matching ignores capitals, curly vs straight quotes,
# dash styles and line breaks. A phrase only matches as whole words.
#
# Lines starting with # are comments.

you have won the lottery
you've won the lottery
claim your prize
pay the processing fee to receive
unclaimed inheritance
inheritance from a distant relative
beneficiary of the funds
pay a withdrawal fee
withdrawal fee required
we can recover your lost funds
